attempts.text:
**The window starts on a spine column.** Column 0, `folK`, sits in every chromosome, persistent, and in a region of plasticity in 0% of calls. The model names it in 99.6% of calls, with 0.20 bits.

**Then the graph opens at columns 1 to 7**, fork and variable columns in a region of plasticity in 59 to 84% of calls. The model names 19 to 66% there, fewest at column 4, named 19%, and hesitates most at column 3, 1.27 bits. The branches carry fimbrial proteins and chaperones, `yadN` to `yadC`, and an IS1-like element transposase.

**A long spine follows, columns 8 to 64**, carried by 92 to 96% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 0.2 to 11% of calls. The model names 58 to 99% there, fewest at column 53 (`murD`), named 58%, and hesitates most at column 10 (`rpnC`), 0.57 bits. The genes run from `panB` and `panC` through [[pantoate and beta-alanine ligation]] to `ilvN` and `ilvI`.

**Two short stretches follow.** Columns 65 to 66 are fork and variable, in a region of plasticity in 0.2% of calls, named 89 to 95%; columns 67 to 71 are spine, `leuL` to `leuD`, [[leucine biosynthesis]], named 95 to 98%. Column 72 is variable, `setA`, named 94%.

**The window ends on forks and spines.** Columns 73 to 74, `sgrT` and `sgrR`, are spine, named 93 to 94%. Columns 75 to 79 are fork and variable, named 95 to 97%, with a second branch of `araD`, `polB` and `rapA` carried by 10 to 16% of chromosomes. The window ends at column 79, `araC`, in 71% of chromosomes.

label: folK
facts:
WINDOW: the folK window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor folK, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 3,572 to 3,651 from dnaA. Read in 540 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying folK once); 43,200 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 91% of genes, 0.20 bits on average (perplexity 1.4 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 38,091 calls, named 97%, 0.12 bits; shell 4,811 calls, named 50%, 0.81 bits; cloud 298 calls, named 7%, 1.75 bits. Outside an RGP 39,404 calls, named 96%, 0.14 bits; inside an RGP 3,796 calls, named 43%, 0.89 bits. Columns: 65 spine, 9 fork, 6 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.89 against 0.14 bits) and names fewer genes (43% against 96%); 3,796 of the 43,200 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 3 (htrE) 1.27 bits, RGP 84%; column 1 (yadN) 1.03 bits, RGP 84%; column 2 (yadV) 0.58 bits, RGP 84%. The 7 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 51%, 0.67 bits on average; the other 73 columns: named 95%, 0.16 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 1-7 (fork and variable columns), RGP 59-84%; the least: column 0 (spine), RGP 0%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: folK. named 99.6%; 0.20 bits.
2. columns 1-7 (7 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 59-84%. named 19-66% (mean 51%), fewest named at column 4, named 19%; most hesitant at column 3, 1.27 bits.
   1 fork: yadN S 58% "fimbrial protein"; also "IS1-like element transposase" S 25%, yadN (another family) S 14%
   2 fork: yadV S 57%; also yadV (another family) S 14%
   3 fork: htrE S 49%; also htrE (another family) S 13%
   4 variable: yadM S 35% "fimbrial protein"
   5 variable: yadL S 35% "fimbrial-like protein YadL"
   6 variable: yadK S 48% "fimbrial-like protein"
   7 fork: yadC S 27% "fimbrial-like adhesin"; also "fimbrial protein" S 11%
3. columns 8-64 (57 columns) spine: share 92-96%, all P, RGP 0.2-11%. Genes: panB, panC "pantoate--beta-alanine ligase", rpnC, panD, yadE, yadI "PTS sugar transporter subunit IIA", yadH "ABC transporter permease", yadG "ATP-binding cassette domain-contain…", can, hpt, gcd, cueO, yacC "YacC family pilotin-like protein", speE "polyamine aminopropyltransferase", speD, yacL "protein YacL", acnB, yacH "DUF3300 domain-containing protein", lpdA, aceF, aceE "pyruvate dehydrogenase (acetyl-tran…", pdhR, aroP, ampE "regulatory signaling modulator prot…", ampD, nadC, ppdD, gspE, hofC, guaC, "protein YacM", coaE, zapD, yacG "DNA gyrase inhibitor YacG", mutT, secA, secM "secA translation cis-regulator SecM", lpxC, ftsZ "cell division protein FtsZ", ftsA, ftsQ, ddlB, murC "UDP-N-acetylmuramate--L-alanine lig…", murG, ftsW, murD, mraY, murF "glutamate ligase domain-containing…", murE, ftsI, ftsL "cell division protein FtsL", rsmH, mraZ, cra, fruR, ilvN "acetolactate synthase small subunit", ilvI. named 58-99% (mean 94%), fewest named at column 53 (murD), named 58%; most hesitant at column 10 (rpnC), 0.57 bits.
4. columns 65-66 (2 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 0.2%. named 89-95% (mean 92%), fewest named at column 65, named 89%; most hesitant at column 66, 0.37 bits.
   65 fork: "protein YabR" S 63%; also "hypothetical protein" S 13%
   66 variable: leuO P 90%
5. columns 67-71 (5 columns) spine: share 94%, all P, RGP 0.2-3%. Genes: leuL, leuA, leuB, leuC "3-isopropylmalate dehydratase large…", leuD. named 95-98% (mean 97%), fewest named at column 71 (leuD), named 95%; most hesitant at column 67 (leuL), 0.32 bits.
6. column 72 variable: RGP 3%. named 94%; 0.34 bits.
   72: setA S 59%
7. columns 73-74 (2 columns) spine: share 91%, all P, RGP 3-4%. Genes: sgrT "glucose uptake inhibitor SgrT", sgrR. named 93-94% (mean 93%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 74 (sgrR), named 93%, 0.40 bits.
8. columns 75-79 (5 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 3%. named 95-97% (mean 96%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 75, named 95%, 0.23 bits.
   a second branch of 3 families through columns 76-78, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 10-16%, all P; the branch's families: araD, polB, rapA
   75 variable: thiB P 89%
   76 fork: thiP P 85%
   77 fork: thiQ P 82% "thiamine ABC transporter ATP-bindin…"
   78 fork: yabI P 79% "DedA family protein"
   79 fork: araC P 71%; also araB P 37%, araA P 22%
PRODUCTS of named genes (for [[ ]]): panB 3-methyl-2-oxobutanoate hydroxymethyltr…; aceF biotin/lipoyl-containing protein; ampD 1,6-anhydro-N-acetylmuramyl-L-alanine a…; secA preprotein translocase subunit SecA; ftsA cell division protein FtsA; ftsQ cell division protein FtsQ; murG undecaprenyldiphospho-muramoylpentapept…; ftsI peptidoglycan glycosyltransferase FtsI; ilvI thiamine pyrophosphate-binding protein; leuB isocitrate/isopropylmalate family dehyd…; leuD 3-isopropylmalate dehydratase small sub…; thiB thiamine ABC transporter substrate-bind…; thiP ABC transporter permease subunit; thiQ thiamine ABC transporter ATP-binding pr…; yadN fimbrial protein; yadV fimbria/pilus periplasmic chaperone; htrE FimD/PapC N-terminal domain-containing…; espY2 T3SS effector EspY2; araD class II aldolase/adducin family protein; polB DNA polymerase II; araB ribulokinase; araA L-arabinose isomerase family protein
END: the window ends at column 79, araC, in 71% of chromosomes.
